name: 02143 · Somerville, MA
findings: ZIP 02143 (Somerville) has 128 nonprofit organizations. 58 of them (45%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 51 organizations.
Housing organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (16% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 02143 (Somerville) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 02143 (Somerville) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 69% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 36 organizations here; 20% of all organizations here have no identified type.
